title: Console Dashboards & Rollout GTM Checklist — Enablement Path and Release Notes Coordination
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Goal: Deliver a tightly coordinated go-to-market run for the upcoming Console dashboards + rollout controls feature that ensures (1) clear customer-facing release notes, (2) an internal enablement path for support/sales/CS, and (3) synchronized timing across Console, Docs, SDKs, and Cost Insights. This ticket owns the cross-team checklist, the release notes versioning, the enablement curriculum outline, and the pre/post rollout comms schedule.

Scope in this ticket: finalizing release-note copy, scheduling internal enablement sessions, creating a short customer-facing FAQ and upgrade instructions, aligning dev and infra for canary rollout windows, and coordinating translation/localization priorities for EU/APAC markets. Does not include engineering implementation tasks (those remain in ENG- tickets) but will track readiness gates and sign-offs.
tasks: Draft canonical release notes (short + long form) and push to release-notes repo
Create 45-min enablement deck for Sales & CS and record a 20-min demo video
Publish a 1-pager FAQ and upgrade instructions to Docs with code snippets and sample API calls
Coordinate with Engineering for canary windows, rollback triggers, and monitoring dashboards
Finalize cost-breakdown language and add example token/throughput scenarios to pricing collateral
Schedule and execute two internal office hours (EMEA/APAC) pre-GA
Collect legal/compliance review for any wording that touches SLAs or customer data controls
Confirm localization scope for top 3 locales and hand off copy to localization team
acceptance_criteria: Release notes merged in release-notes repo and approved by tech writer and PM
Enablement deck and demo video uploaded to Drive and referenced in the internal enablement calendar
Docs page with upgrade instructions published and smoke-tested by Engineering
On-call and SRE runbook updated with canary monitoring thresholds and rollback steps
Sales & CS have at least one live walkthrough and recorded session available
Customer-facing announcement draft ready and scheduled in the comms calendar
Localization tickets created and assigned for translated release notes/FAQ
